honors: 國立臺灣藝術大學設計學院多媒體動畫藝術學系 114 學年度畢業創作影片補助
honors_en: NTUA Department of Multimedia & Animation Arts Graduation Project Grant
desc: 基於皮亞傑認知發展理論設計之 VR 哲學解謎遊戲。體驗者化身虛擬生命體 12T06，透過手部控制器操作與物理回饋，經歷感知探索、符號表徵、具體運算至抽象推理之意識覺醒歷程。
desc_en: VR philosophy puzzle game designed around Piaget's cognitive development theory. Players embody artificial lifeform 12T06, utilizing hand controllers and physical feedback to progress from sensory exploration to abstract reasoning.
contributions: 事件驅動架構：採用 EDA 與事件委派機制，整合 Singleton、Observer 與 Registry 模式，實作 UI、音訊、動畫與物理機關組件之結構性解耦。
VR 物理互動與關卡邏輯：基於 XR Interaction Toolkit 實作 6-DoF 手部抓取與機關觸發；獨立編寫音階觸發序列、代數算式驗證與迷宮路徑重置演算法。
渲染管線與自訂著色器：採用 URP 與 UV 頂點對齊色票技術，編寫 Hard Edge Outline 拓撲線條著色器插件，實現極簡賽博龐克視覺風格。
動畫控制：運用 Timeline 處理開頭文本動畫，並使用 DOTween 實現場景物件動畫。
AIGC 音訊生成：整合 DeepVoice Pro 語音合成與 Suno AI 聲場演算，建構空間音訊體驗。
contributions_en: Event-Driven Architecture (EDA): Employed EDA with event delegation mechanisms, integrating Singleton, Observer, and Registry patterns for structural component decoupling across UI, audio, animations, and physics.
VR Physics & Level Logic: Implemented 6-DoF hand grabbing and interactive mechanics via XR Interaction Toolkit; programmed musical pitch triggers, algebraic validation, and maze path resets.
Render Pipeline & Custom Shaders: Leveraged URP and UV vertex alignment color palette techniques; authored a custom Hard Edge Outline topology line shader for minimalist cyberpunk visuals.
Animation Control: Utilized Timeline for opening text sequence animations, and DOTween for interactive object animations.
AIGC Audio Generation: Integrated DeepVoice Pro speech synthesis and Suno AI sound generation to construct a spatial audio experience.

honors: 2022 全國大專及高中職學生專題製作競賽成果展示 - 第一名
2022 Unreal Engine 5 臺灣遊戲創意設計大賽 - 佳作
2023 放視大賞遊戲組 - 初選入圍
honors_en: 1st Place in National Special Topic Contest
UE5 Taiwan Game Contest - Merit Award
desc: 基於 Unreal Engine 5 開發之 3D 多人合作第一人稱射擊遊戲。玩家需於限時內協同對抗敵群並採集星球能源，考驗戰術反應與射擊操作。榮獲 2022 全國大專專題製作競賽第一名及 2022 UE5 臺灣遊戲創意設計大賽佳作。
desc_en: 3D co-op FPS game built with Unreal Engine 5. Players engage in tactical combat against enemy hordes and gather planet energy under tight time constraints. Winner of 1st Place in the National Special Topic Contest and Merit Award in the UE5 Taiwan Game Contest.
contributions: 核心系統全藍圖開發：獨立建構玩家控制器、核心 UI 狀態流與關卡狀態機切換機制。
AI 行為與感知系統：運用 Behavior Tree 與 AIPerception，實作怪物巡邏、感知追擊、動態包圍與戰術移動邏輯。
地形與 3D 資產整合：負責 Landscape 巨型地形編輯、3D 武器模型製作、LOD 效能優化與引擎導入。
contributions_en: Core Blueprints Dev: Independently built Player Controller, UI state flow, and level state machine switching logic.
AI Behavior & Perception: Integrated Behavior Tree & AIPerception for enemy patrolling, tactical flanking, and siege logic.
Terrain & 3D Assets: Landscape giant terrain editing, 3D weapon modeling, LOD optimization, and engine asset pipeline.

desc: 以 React 19 與 TypeScript 建構之個人作品集與視覺化 CMS 管理後臺。前端採用 Tailwind CSS 實作賽博風格與高對比深淺色介面；資料層架構本地快照搭配 Firebase Firestore 雙向即時監聽；後端整合 Firebase Auth 權限控管與 Cloudflare Workers 邊緣部署。
desc_en: A personal portfolio and visual CMS dashboard built with React 19 and TypeScript. Features a cyberpunk high-contrast theme via Tailwind CSS, local snapshot with real-time Firebase Firestore synchronization, Firebase Auth access control, and Cloudflare Workers edge deployment.
contributions: CMS 視覺化管理後臺：為首頁、簡介、技能、專案與經歷等展示模組打造專用管理介面，實作未儲存防跳出機制（Unsaved Guard）與多語系即時同步。
資料快取與即時同步：結合本地靜態 JSON 與 Firestore onSnapshot 串流監聽，達到首屏即時呈現與後臺儲存無須重整即時反映之混合資料流。
身分驗證與安全控管：串接 Firebase Authentication 實作管理員登入流程與 Token 生命週期管理，保護後臺資料操作邊界。
多媒體與雲端資產管理：串接 Firebase Storage 支援圖片資產上傳，並實作 SVG 技術圖示與動態靜態資源映射。
互動視覺與無障礙設計：實作 Canvas 粒子互動背景、發光游標與進場動畫，並嚴格遵循深淺色對比度規範。
CI/CD 自動化建構與部署：配置 GitHub Actions 工作流於推送時自動執行型別驗證與打包，並自動發布至 Cloudflare Workers。
contributions_en: Visual CMS Admin Dashboard: Developed dedicated management interfaces for Hero, About, Skills, Projects, and Experience modules, with unsaved changes warnings and multi-language synchronization.
Data Caching & Real-Time Sync: Combined local static JSON with Firestore onSnapshot listeners to achieve immediate first-paint and instant cloud sync without page refreshes.
Authentication & Security: Integrated Firebase Authentication for administrator sign-in and token session lifecycle management.
Cloud Media Asset Management: Leveraged Firebase Storage for image uploads alongside dynamic SVG icon and static asset mapping.
Interactive Visuals & Accessibility: Built Canvas particle background, custom cursor, and smooth scroll animations adhering to high-contrast accessibility guidelines.
CI/CD & Edge Deployment: Configured GitHub Actions to run type checks and automated builds on push, deploying automatically to Cloudflare Workers.

desc: 灰階懷舊風格之 2D 音效同步動作跑酷遊戲。透過即時音訊頻譜動態驅動 UI、視覺特效、鏡頭運動與背景變化，打造視聽高度同步之沉浸體驗。
desc_en: Grayscale 2D audio-synced action runner. Real-time audio spectrum drives dynamic UI, particle VFX, camera shake, and background shifts.
contributions: 即時頻譜解析與映射：呼叫 AudioSource.GetSpectrumData 解析即時頻譜數據，將特定頻段動態映射至場景物件縮放與粒子特效。
Cinemachine 動態運鏡：整合 Cinemachine 實作程序化鏡頭震動與追蹤軌跡，並與音訊頻譜數據即時連動。
全域狀態與資料持久化：導入 Singleton 模式管理全域音訊狀態機，並透過 PlayerPrefs 實作輕量化數據非同步存檔。
contributions_en: Real-Time Spectrum Mapping: Utilized AudioSource.GetSpectrumData for frequency amplitude mapping to procedural object scaling and particle VFX.
Cinemachine Dynamic Camera: Linked procedural camera shake and tracking trajectory with real-time audio spectrum beat detection.
Global State & Persistence: Employed Singleton pattern for global audio state machine and PlayerPrefs for lightweight data persistence.

desc: 結合 AR 空間感測技術之新竹神社歷史文化導覽互動遊戲。使用者可透過觸發互動任務探索歷史故事，並載入 ScriptableObject 模組化題庫進行文化知識選擇題測驗。
desc_en: AR spatial observation interactive guide for Hsinchu Shrine. Users trigger interactive quests to explore cultural stories and complete multiple-choice quizzes powered by modular ScriptableObject datasets.
contributions: AR 識別與空間定位：整合 Vuforia SDK 實作 AR 圖像識別與空間座標定位，處理虛實物件疊加。
歷史題庫與測驗架構：運用 ScriptableObject 建立模組化問答題庫資料結構，解耦歷史考據文字、題目選項與回饋判定，大幅提升題型維護彈性。
過場編排與狀態管理：運用 Timeline 系統精確控制過場動畫與音訊同步；採用 Singleton 模式管理全域場景載入與任務數據。
contributions_en: AR Tracking & Placement: Vuforia SDK image targeting and spatial coordinate positioning for virtual object overlay.
Quiz System & ScriptableObject: Built modular question data structures with ScriptableObject, decoupling quiz choices and scoring criteria for flexible maintenance.
Cutscenes & State Management: Timeline system for camera animation and audio sync; Singleton pattern for scene loading & quest state.

desc: 結合籃球投擲與環保分類教育之兒童 VR 沉浸式體驗遊戲。採用 ScriptableObject 配置題目資料與回收屬性，引導玩家將各類垃圾投擲至正確回收桶以學習資源分類。
desc_en: Educational VR basketball game combining trash sorting with physics throwing mechanics. Utilizes ScriptableObject to configure quiz datasets and classification attributes for interactive learning.
contributions: VR 物理互動開發：利用 Meta Quest SDK 實作手勢追蹤、控制器輸入映射與實體抓取邏輯，處理投籃物理軌跡與碰撞反饋。
題庫資料與分類配置：使用 ScriptableObject 定義問題題目與物件回收屬性容器，將垃圾品項、環保題目與分值邏輯資料化，支援無痛擴充新題目。
流程與計分狀態控管：導入 Singleton 模式管理全域計分系統、計時器與關卡流程切換。
contributions_en: VR Physics & Grab: Meta Quest SDK hand tracking, controller input mapping, physics grabbing, and throwing trajectory feedback.
Quiz & Sorting Data Architecture: Leveraged ScriptableObject containers for question datasets and recycling attributes, enabling seamless expansion of items.
State & Scoring System: Singleton pattern for global score tracking, timer, and stage flow control.

honors: 2021 第四屆臺灣數位媒體設計獎 - 大專組互動科技應用 - 銀賞
honors_en: 2021 4th Taiwan Digital Media Design Award - Interactive Tech Silver Medal
desc: 針對空中巴士 A330 客機檢修訓練開發之跨平臺行動學習軟體，以煞車器拆解與安裝模擬為核心教案。
desc_en: Cross-platform interactive learning app for Airbus A330 brake assembly maintenance training.
contributions: UI/UX 視覺系統獨立設計：獨立負責全套專業檢修介面視覺設計與美術素材製作（版面、按鈕、狀態指示圖標）。
UGUI 流程與狀態機建置：將自製素材導入 Unity 規劃 UGUI 邏輯，編寫複雜檢修步驟的核心互動機制與流程切換。
contributions_en: UI/UX Visual Design: Independently designed full aviation maintenance interface, layout, buttons, and status icons.
UGUI Logic & State Machine: Integrated custom assets into Unity UGUI to program complex interactive maintenance procedures.

honors: 2023 通訊大賽聯網未來挑戰賽 - 決賽入圍
desc: 基於情境教學與語言學習開發之 VTuber 虛擬角色互動直播與簡報系統 (VAILSS)。學習者透過扮演虛擬角色進行情境模擬，提升語言表達能力。
desc_en: VTuber virtual character presentation system (VAILSS) for contextual language learning. Responsible for core 3D character assets, environment topology, and visual tuning.
contributions: 3D 角色與場景資產建置：獨立負責核心虛擬角色與 3D 故事場景建置、拓撲減面與引擎內資產效能調校。
動態導覽與展演影像製作：負責全案動態導覽流程編排、視聽效果調校與展演影片剪輯製作。
contributions_en: 3D Character & Environment Assets: Built core virtual characters and 3D scenes, topology polygon reduction, and engine performance tuning.
Motion Navigation & Video Production: Directed dynamic tour navigation, audio-visual tuning, and showcase video editing.

desc: 基於 Angular 與 TypeScript 開發之動態問卷系統。實作響應式表單驗證、非同步資料串流處理、多題型動態渲染與填答統計儀表板。
desc_en: Dynamic survey platform built with Angular and TypeScript. Features reactive form validation, asynchronous data streaming, multi-question type dynamic rendering, and a response analytics dashboard.
contributions: 動態表單與狀態串流：運用 Angular Reactive Forms 與 RxJS 實作條件跳轉題型與即時輸入驗證邏輯。
模組化題型體系：採用 Angular 獨立元件架構建構題型元件庫，支援單複選、量表題型與填答進度計算。
RESTful API 與暫存機制：設計型別安全的 DTO 資料合約，結合 HttpClient 處理即時自動暫存與網路異常重試。
contributions_en: Dynamic Reactive Forms & State: Built conditional branching logic and real-time form validation with Angular Reactive Forms & RxJS.
Modular Survey Components: Developed scalable standalone question components supporting multiple choice, rating scales, and progress tracking.
RESTful DTO Contracts: Implemented type-safe HTTP communication with auto-save support and error handling.

desc: 基於 React 與 Node.js 開發之全端電商系統。包含商品型錄檢索、購物車持久化快取、模擬金流結帳流程與後臺訂單管理功能。
desc_en: Full-stack e-commerce application built with React and Node.js. Features product catalog browsing, persistent cart caching, checkout simulation, and order management.
contributions: 購物車與全域狀態管理：採用 Context API 與本地儲存同步機制，維護跨頁面購物車狀態與數量校驗。
後端 API 與資料庫設計：以 Express 與 PostgreSQL 設計 RESTful API 端點，落實資料庫交易與庫存扣減防護。
商品瀏覽與檢索介面：實作虛擬滾動列表優化海量商品渲染效能，並整合多條件篩選與即時搜尋功能。
contributions_en: Cart & Global State Management: Maintained persistent cart state and quantity validation across routes using React Context API.
Backend API & Database: Designed RESTful endpoints and relational PostgreSQL schema ensuring safe transactions and inventory updates.
Catalog UI & Search: Implemented virtual scrolling for large catalog datasets alongside multi-criteria filtering.
